info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Partner Application API
info.description: The Update Partner Application API allows businesses to modify the details of existing applications submitted by partners. This endpoint is particularly useful for managing changes or corrections to application data, ensuring the information remains up-to-date. Typical consumers include partner relationship managers and application administrators who need to make adjustments based on partner feedback or internal requirements. By providing a streamlined way to update application details, this API enhances operational efficiency and partner satisfaction.

put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific partner application identified by the resource ID (RES-100045). Use this endpoint to modify existing information related to the application based on the provided payload.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the application with ID RES-100045. It contains the necessary data to modify the existing application details.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource is updated.
